title: ICD-10 Annual Update Coding Discrepancy with Fee Schedule Lag
scenario_text:
**Cerner RevCycle -- AR Aging Report (pulled 03/15/2026):**
$387,000 in claims aged 60+ days | Filter: DOS 10/01/2025 -- 12/31/2025 | Payer: MN State Medicaid (MHCP) | Common denial: CO-11 ("Diagnosis is inconsistent with procedure") | 23 claims affected | All coded with ICD-10 codes from FY2026 update (effective 10/01/2025)

**Epic -- Coding Queue Notes (11/15/2025):**
Coder note (T. Andersen): "FY2026 ICD-10 update loaded into Epic encoder on 10/01. All encounters DOS 10/01+ coded per new guidelines. HCC-relevant specificity codes now required per CMS memo."

**SharePoint -- /revcycle/fee-schedules/MHCP-FY2026-fee-schedule.xlsx:**
File properties: Last modified: 01/12/2026 | Uploaded by: billing.admin
Sheet notes: "MHCP published updated fee schedule 01/05/2026, effective retroactive to 10/01/2025. Crosswalk file maps old codes to new reimbursement rates."

**Outlook -- Email (12/02/2025):**
From: provider.relations@mhcp.state.mn.us
To: billing@vantagehp.org
Subject: IMPORTANT: FY2026 Code Update -- Processing Delay Notice

"Please be advised that MHCP claim processing systems will not accept FY2026 ICD-10 codes until our system update completes (estimated January 2026). Claims submitted with new codes before system update will be denied. Providers may submit using FY2025 codes with modifier -32 (mandated services) for tracking, or hold claims until system update."

**Slack -- #coding-compliance (unofficial, 12/03/2025, 11:22 AM):**
@tina.andersen: Just got the MHCP bulletin. They want us to use OLD codes even though CMS says new codes are required as of 10/1? That's a compliance conflict.
@dr.reshma.gupta (CMO): If we code with old codes we're technically submitting inaccurate diagnoses. That's a false claims risk.
@michelle.torres: Agreed. We code accurately per CMS. If MHCP denies, we appeal with the bulletin as evidence of their system limitation. Do NOT downcode.
@tina.andersen: Got it. Keeping FY2026 codes. Flagging all MHCP claims DOS 10/1-12/31 for manual appeal tracking.
[Thread end -- no further replies]

**Compliance 360 -- Open Item #C360-2025-0441:**
Title: "MHCP FY2026 Coding Discrepancy" | Status: Under Review | Opened: 12/04/2025 | Owner: Compliance Committee | Last update (01/20/2026): "MHCP system updated. New codes now accepted. Retroactive processing confirmed. Appeal window for previously denied claims: 120 days from original denial date."

**Cerner RevCycle -- Denial Dates on 23 claims:**
Earliest denial: 11/15/2025 | Latest denial: 01/08/2026
question: What is the correct action for the 23 denied MHCP claims totaling $387K, and what is the deadline risk?

contributor.name: Michelle Torres
contributor.title: Revenue Cycle Director
contributor.domain_expertise: Claims management, denial resolution, patient identity matching, payer contract interpretation

choices: Appeal all 23 claims with FY2026 codes citing the MHCP bulletin, but prioritize the 11 claims denied on 11/15/2025 since their 120-day appeal window closes on 03/15/2026 -- the day the AR report was pulled
Appeal all 23 claims with the original FY2026 codes now that MHCP's system accepts them, citing the MHCP processing delay bulletin as cause; all claims are within the 120-day appeal window

Recode the claims to FY2025 codes to match the fee schedule that was active at DOS, since the retroactive fee schedule was not uploaded to SharePoint until 01/12/2026 and may not have been applied to these claims
Resubmit all 23 claims with FY2025 ICD-10 codes and modifier -32 as MHCP originally instructed; the claims are within timely filing and this resolves the CO-11 denial
